retrieval_limitations: Block-explorer API and height-page requests did not return readable chain data through the web tool. No independent raw-block timestamp verification is claimed.
Core release notes and Optech’s 17 November report establish the height but do not explicitly state 14 November; the exact day was separately checked against Blockstream’s documentation.
release_guardrails: Keep 14 November 2021 as the activation date and 709632 as the visible tag.
Do not conflate Schnorr, Taproot and Tapscript or imply ECDSA vanished from Bitcoin.
Keep privacy conditional on construction and spending path; amounts and transaction relationships are not made universally secret.
Do not imply an automatic, network-wide fee cut or instant wallet adoption.
Do not refer to the removed branch bag or hidden sleeve from earlier image versions.
Use the four clue crops in the specified order; preserve the approved final brown-handled tools.
The grafting scene and SegWit charm are editorial symbolism, not documentary artefacts.
